prompt: Edit this unapproved teacher dashboard design with only these corrections; preserve all group data, table structure, navigation, institution name, page spacing, calm white work area and Spanish controls. Make the entire left navigation rail a FLAT solid luminous emerald #48B292, with NO gradient, shading or dark emerald. Use deep green #17352D for navigation labels and icons on that rail so they remain readable on the lighter brand color. Keep Mis grupos visibly selected with a light mint surface and deep green text. The Nueva tarea primary button may remain dark green with white text. Replace the period field value 'Enero – Junio 2025' with the exact words 'Período de ejemplo'; do not invent or imply an approved academic calendar. Keep the bottom-right 'Boceto · Datos ficticios' marker. The remaining example rows and dates are demonstration material. Do not redesign the layout, add ornaments or add new statistics. This should remain a simple professional academic working panel, with the user’s light emerald visibly and precisely represented.
initialPrompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop teacher web-app UI design proposal for Instituto Tecnológico de San Miguel, edge to edge landscape, no device or browser frame, crisp Spanish text. This is a QUIET FUNCTIONAL PANEL, not a marketing landing page. Mark the screen 'Boceto · Datos ficticios'. The teacher's immediate task is choosing one assigned group, reviewing its submissions and creating an assignment. Use a conventional left navigation rail, clear top utility bar, a central aligned group table and a small upcoming-deadlines area. Sidebar labels: Inicio, Mis grupos (selected), Tareas, Entregas, Calendario, Mi perfil. Header shows full institution name and role Docente, ES/EN and Claro / Oscuro / Sistema controls. Main heading 'Mis grupos', concise subtitle 'Consulta tus grupos asignados y revisa las entregas pendientes', and one 'Nueva tarea' primary action. Filters directly over the table: Buscar grupo and Período de ejemplo. Show three realistic illustrative rows with columns Grupo, Materia, Estudiantes, Por revisar and action 'Abrir grupo': A01 / Programación I / 14 / 5; B01 / Programación I / 12 / 3; R01 / Fundamentos de redes / 10 / 4. These subject names are example content, not approved curriculum. Use luminous emerald #48B292 for the rail and selected states, cool white main work surfaces and deep green text; selected navigation is clearly readable, with restrained typography and generous aligned spacing. No decorative campus photo, gradients, charts, gamification or animation. Primary layout priority is finding the right group without confusion; do not show private data or grades for students outside assigned groups.
content: Subjects, groups, dates and counts are illustrative, not an approved curriculum or calendar.
